summary: completeTask reopens a RecurringTask at its next occurrence

ops.spec: Marks a Task as done. If the Task is already done, this is a no-op (idempotent) — it does not error and does not un-complete it. For a RecurringTask, completing the current occurrence advances dueDate to the next occurrence computed from recurrenceRule and leaves the Task not done, so it is immediately open again for that next occurrence.

tests: completing a RecurringTask leaves done false
completing a RecurringTask due 2026-08-05 with rule 'every 3 days' sets dueDate to 2026-08-08
